entries.102995eaf6b87791: This is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells automotive glass and cover glass for in-vehicle displays. Companies including Aijiexu Qiche Boli (Suzhou) Co., Ltd., AGC Flat Glass North America, Inc., AGC Automotive Europe and AGC Automotive Czech a.s. are responsible for it. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥520,324 million, second among the reportable segments, and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥29,252 million. The number of employees was 15,997, the largest of the five reportable segments, capital expenditure was ¥43,058 million, and R&D expenses were ¥6,899 million. The company explains that revenue and profit increased, as shipments rose in Japan although they fell in Europe, and as product mix improvements and price policy effects in all regions and the revenue impact of the weaker yen contributed. In Japan, the Aichi Plant and the Sagami Plant have manufacturing facilities for automotive glass.
entries.15df56bbd33804fa: A division that handles various ceramics products and logistics and financial services, among others.
entries.2680ea2458fa8c67: A division that undertakes development and manufacturing of biopharmaceutical drug substances; the company states that it accounts for half of the Life Science segment's sales. The company states that while the microbial and gene/cell therapy fields maintain stable quality and a solid track record, winning orders in the animal cell field is a challenge, and it is implementing improvement measures in sequence, including strengthening sales and marketing, using the group's production technology capabilities, and cutting costs. It is carried out by AGC Biologics A/S of Denmark, and the Colorado site in the U.S. has been withdrawn.
entries.27ef632f5977b204: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells flat glass for buildings and processed architectural glass such as insulated glass, tempered glass and laminated glass. It is carried out by AGC Glass Building Materials Co., Ltd., AGC Glass Products Co., Ltd., PT Asahimas Flat Glass Tbk, AGC Glass Europe, AGC Flat Glass Czech a.s. and others. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales to external customers were ¥438,811 million, segment profit (operating profit) was ¥17,263 million, the number of employees was 12,697, capital expenditure was ¥33,085 million and R&D expenses were ¥4,366 million. The company explains that in Europe and the Americas, although there was a revenue decrease from lower shipments in Europe and from the transfer of the Russian business in February 2024, the revenue-increasing effects of pricing policies and the weaker yen outweighed it, and that in Asia results fell below the previous year owing to lower shipments and lower selling prices in Indonesia and elsewhere. It cites expanding sales of highly insulating, heat-shielding products such as Low-E insulated glass and vacuum insulated glass as a challenge.
entries.28081ec7afe239f7: A reportable segment that handles contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) of synthetic pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals, contract development and manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals, and intermediates and active ingredients for pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals. It is carried out by AGC Biologics A/S (Denmark) and others, and in Japan the Chiba Plant has manufacturing facilities for synthetic pharmaceutical and agrochemical intermediates and active ingredients and for biopharmaceutical drug substances. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales to external customers were ¥129,420 million and the segment result was a loss of ¥22,261 million, the only loss among the reportable segments. The number of employees was 2,967, capital expenditure was ¥28,140 million and R&D expenses were ¥1,088 million. The company explains that although the synthetic pharmaceutical and agrochemical CDMO business performed firmly, revenue decreased because of the absence of one-time income from the settlement of a contracted project recorded in the previous year in the biopharmaceutical CDMO business and the closure of the Colorado site in the U.S., among other factors. Winning orders in the animal cell field of biopharmaceutical CDMO, which accounts for half of this business's sales, is a challenge, and the company expects to return to profitability in 2027.
entries.28f85a34bbd973d7: A division that develops and manufactures intermediates and active ingredients of pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals on commission from customers.
entries.2b5247a4d8265568: This is a reportable segment consisting of the 'Display' business, which handles glass substrates for liquid crystal and organic EL displays and specialty glass for displays, and the 'Electronic Materials' business, which handles semiconductor-related and optical-related materials. AGC Electronics Co., Ltd., AGC Techno Glass Co., Ltd., Aijiexu Xianshi Boli Gufen Youxian Gongsi (Taiwan), Aijiexu Xianshi Boli (Huizhou) Co., Ltd., Aijiexu Xinxing Dianzi Xianshi Boli (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd., AGC Fine Techno Korea Co., Ltd. and others are responsible for it. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥353,227 million, and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥47,536 million, the second-largest profit scale among the reportable segments. The number of employees was 10,832, capital expenditure was ¥52,937 million, and R&D expenses were ¥13,326 million, the largest R&D expenses among the five reportable segments. The company explains that the Display business exceeded the previous year due to higher shipments of glass substrates for liquid crystal displays, while the Electronic Materials business fell below the previous year because Optoelectronics was in a transition toward further higher functionality and shipments of EUV exposure photomask blanks declined; it also states that operating profit was affected by costs recorded in connection with the decision to withdraw from the chemically strengthened specialty glass business.
entries.42f2ffd0a88e6569: The company in charge of the architectural glass business in Asia, including Japan. Together with "Architectural Glass Europe and the Americas", it forms one reportable segment, "Architectural Glass". The company states that in Japan, renovation demand provides underlying support and it is advancing pricing policies and sales expansion of high-value-added products, and that in Southeast Asia, demand is increasing gradually but the competitive environment is intensifying, so it will continue strengthening its sales and distribution networks and raising value added. In Japan, the Kashima Plant has manufacturing facilities for flat glass for buildings.
entries.442d563c2b961da9: The company in charge of the architectural glass business in Europe and the Americas.
entries.443516c2b3be1486: A reportable segment that handles contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) of synthetic pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals, contract development and manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals, and intermediates and active ingredients for pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals.
entries.514807cdf37ff238: A division that develops and manufactures intermediates and active ingredients of pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals on commission from customers. The company states that it maintains stable quality and a solid track record. In 2019 it acquired all shares of Malgrat Pharma Chemicals (now AGC Pharma Chemicals Europe, S.L.U.) of Spain and began its synthetic pharmaceutical contract development and manufacturing business in that country.

entries.5a1105ee180faee3: A division that undertakes development and manufacturing of biopharmaceutical drug substances; the company states that it accounts for half of the Life Science segment's sales.
entries.5c8bfba73befae1a: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells "Essential Chemicals," such as caustic soda, vinyl chloride resin and urethane raw materials, and "Performance Chemicals," such as fluorine products (resins, gases, solvents) and iodine products. It is carried out by Ise Chemicals Corporation, PT Asahimas Chemical, AGC Vinythai Public Company Limited and others. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, net sales to external customers were ¥579,487 million, the largest of the 5 reportable segments, and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥53,035 million, also the largest. The number of employees was 6,667 and capital expenditure was ¥90,197 million, the largest among the 5 reportable segments, used for expanding chlor-alkali product manufacturing facilities in Southeast Asia and fluorine-related product manufacturing facilities in Japan. Research and development expenses were ¥11,271 million. As the reason for the decrease in sales, the company cites a fall in the selling price of vinyl chloride resin in Essential Chemicals, while it explains that Performance Chemicals saw an increase in sales thanks to pricing policy and higher shipments of fluorine-related products for electronics and mobility.
entries.662e0de32248d2bf: A division that handles semiconductor-related materials and optical-related materials.
entries.73f88560d11b793b: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells automotive glass and cover glass for in-vehicle displays.
entries.7adbeb2c8db3a823: A division that handles various ceramics products and logistics and financial services, among others. The company has five reportable segments, "Architectural Glass", "Automotive", "Electronics", "Chemicals" and "Life Science", and this division is placed outside the reportable segments. It includes AGC Ceramics Co., Ltd., AGC Singapore Services Pte. Ltd., AGC America, Inc., AGC Capital, Inc. and others. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales to external customers were ¥37,560 million, segment profit (operating profit) was ¥2,588 million, the number of employees was 3,736 and R&D expenses were ¥3,357 million. The ceramics business began in 1916 with the production of refractory bricks, a structural material for glass melting furnaces.

entries.d6b9bd04ac61f235: The company in charge of the architectural glass business in Europe and the Americas. The company has six companies organized by product and service. Of these, "Architectural Glass Europe and the Americas" and "Architectural Glass Asia" are combined into one reportable segment, "Architectural Glass", because they are judged to share economic characteristics, given that the architectural glass business as a whole advances shared efforts on information sharing about technology development and production related to float and architectural processing, on creating social value such as GHG reduction, and on long-term profit indicators, and given the similarity of their products and sales markets. The company states that in Europe, demand remains sluggish but prices are being maintained at an appropriate level thanks to improved supply and demand, and that in South America demand is firm with economic growth.
entries.e1277afbac1b0562: A category handling fluorine products (resins, gases, solvents) and iodine products.
entries.e304841c65db8974: A materials manufacturer handling flat glass for buildings and automobiles, glass substrates for displays, caustic soda and fluorine products, and contract development and manufacturing of pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals.
entries.ec28e86ba97822f4: A category handling fluorine products (resins, gases, solvents) and iodine products. The company states that it focuses on high-profit products in the 3 fields of electronics, energy and mobility. It develops new products and technologies that make use of its core technologies of fluorine chemistry, polymer chemistry, inorganic chemistry and electrochemistry, and the environmentally friendly fluorine-based solvent "AMOLEA" is cited as a product developed using materials informatics.
entries.ed2c5f784d1bf8dd: A category handling caustic soda, vinyl chloride resin and urethane raw materials. The company distinguishes the chlor-alkali and urethane products business in Japan and the functional chemicals business, which has its development and manufacturing functions mainly in Japan, as the "Integrated Chemicals Business," and the chlor-alkali business in the Southeast Asia region as the "Essential Chemicals Southeast Asia Business." The company states that demand within Southeast Asia is growing at an average of about 4% per year, and that in particular demand for caustic soda for alumina and nickel refining in Indonesia is increasing, while market prices of vinyl chloride resin and caustic soda remain weak.
entries.ed846f8441324583: Semiconductor-Related Materials (EUV Exposure Photomask Blanks, CMP Slurry)
entries.f32154afcef11765: A division that handles semiconductor-related materials and optical-related materials. It supplies EUV exposure photomask blanks and CMP slurry for the front-end processes of semiconductor manufacturing. The company states that optoelectronics is in a transition period toward higher functionality and that semiconductor-related materials are generally continuing to grow, and that it will now also focus on back-end semiconductor processes, expanding semiconductor packaging-related technologies and solutions by leveraging its strength of holding inorganic materials, organic materials, and functional design and processing technologies in an integrated manner.
entries.feb3011868d379e0: Intermediates and Active Ingredients for Pharmaceuticals and Agrochemicals
entries.ffc9753367c485f4: This is a division that handles glass substrates for liquid crystal / organic EL displays and specialty glass for displays. Related companies in Taiwan, Huizhou (China), Shenzhen (China) and Gumi (Korea) are responsible for manufacturing and selling glass substrates. The company states that profitability has steadily improved through business restructuring and strengthened competitiveness based on pricing policy and technological innovation. Additionally, the company has decided to withdraw from the chemically strengthened specialty glass business.
